login_description: Enter your credentials to access the clinical screening environment and children analytics.
signup_join_description: Begin early, ethical cognitive screening with AI support. Together, we can identify learning challenges early and ensure every child gets the support they deserve.
signup_feature_1: Early screening insights powered by AI
signup_feature_3: Designed for parents, educators, and researchers
signup_create_subtitle: Begin early, ethical cognitive screening with AI support
signup_agreement_text: I understand that NeuroBloom provides screening insights, not medical diagnosis. All results should be reviewed with qualified healthcare professionals.
signup_privacy_note: Your information is encrypted and protected. We never share your data without explicit consent.
landing_hero_subtitle: NeuroBloom uses fun games and AI magic to discover your child's unique learning powers and help them shine.
landing_how_subtitle: A magical journey to understand how your child learns best
landing_how_step1_desc: Kids play fun, interactive levels while we quietly learn about their unique reading and thinking styles.
landing_how_step2_desc: Our friendly AI looks at play patterns and reading speed to find hidden strengths and challenges.
landing_how_step3_desc: Receive a special 'Power Report' with tips and next steps to help your child level up in school!
landing_why_subtitle: Built with responsibility, backed by science, designed for impact
landing_why_feature1_desc: Identify potential learning challenges before they become obstacles, giving children the support they need.
landing_why_feature2_desc: We provide screening insights only. All results should be reviewed with qualified healthcare professionals.
landing_why_feature3_desc: Your child's data is encrypted, secure, and never shared without explicit consent. HIPAA-aligned practices.
landing_why_feature4_desc: Whether you're an educator or a parent, NeuroBloom provides accessible insights for every stakeholder.
landing_who_subtitle: Supporting everyone involved in a child's learning journey
landing_who_parents_desc: Gain peace of mind with early insights into your child's cognitive development and learning patterns.
landing_who_educators_desc: Identify students who may benefit from additional support and tailor interventions effectively.
landing_who_researchers_desc: Access anonymized data and insights to advance understanding of early cognitive development.
landing_ethics_subtitle: NeuroBloom is built on a foundation of ethical AI, transparency, and child-centered design
landing_ethics_item1_desc: We never claim to diagnose. Our platform provides screening insights to guide further professional evaluation.
landing_ethics_item2_desc: Every data point is protected with industry-leading security. Consent is required at every step.
landing_cta_title: Start Your Screening Journey with NeuroBloom
landing_cta_subtitle: Join hundreds of parents and educators using AI-powered insights to support children's learning.
landing_footer_tagline: Early cognitive insight for brighter futures.
landing_footer_copyright: © 2026 NeuroBloom. All rights reserved. For screening purposes only, not medical diagnosis.
dash_select_env: Select an environment to begin children screening.
assess_review_manage: Review and manage children detection reports.
path_desc: 60-day game-based intervention courses auto-generated from each child's detected learning disability.
path_no_plans_desc: Personalised paths will appear here once a child's test report is generated.
path_delete_record: Delete this child's record? This cannot be undone.
path_delete_disability: Delete this child's disability record? This cannot be undone.
path_analysis_desc: This child has a completed assessment report but the disability detection analysis has not been run yet. Click below to run the full AI pipeline and generate the personalised learning path.
tc_data_usage_desc: Assessment data is used solely for identifying cognitive patterns. Analysis is performed by encrypted AI models with no third-party data extraction.
tc_privacy_desc: Multi-layer AES-256 encryption. Personally Identifiable Information (PII) is anonymized before clinical processing.
tc_medical_desc: This is a diagnostic aid tool. Results must be validated by a licensed clinical professional or educational psychologist.
tc_guardian_desc: By proceeding, you verify you are the legal guardian and authorize the collection of biometric and reading performance data.
tc_accept: I accept the clinical terms & conditions
ps_warning: Clinical assessment requires active audio-visual monitoring and neural telemetry via Mindwave.
ps_validation: Hardware validation verified by NeuroBloom Core
ps_err_hw: Hardware initialization failed. Please check your connections.
tcomp_adventure_complete: Adventure Complete! You've finished all 6 levels.
tcomp_results_processing: Your results are being processed. A detailed AI report will be in your dashboard soon!

game_w1_text:
I wake up early when the sun smiles at me.
I brush my teeth and get ready for school.
My school bag is full of books and dreams.
I love learning letters, numbers, and new words.
My teacher helps me and my friends every day.
We play, draw, and sing happy songs together.
At lunch, I share my food and laugh a lot.
When I go home, I tell my parents all about my day.
